project.description: Contains information about the Emulsify project.

platform.description: Name of the platform Emulsify is being used within.

name.description: Name of the project, such as 'Carmen Sandiego'.

machineName.description: Machine-friendly name of the project, such as 'carmen-sandiego'.

singleDirectoryComponents.description: Whether Drupal Single Directory Component output mirroring is enabled.

generatedFrom.description: Name of the Emulsify project that generated this project.

generatedFromVersion.description: Version of the Emulsify project that generated this project.

description.description: Human-facing description of the generated project.

assetRoots.description: Compatibility alias for additional project-relative asset directories. Prefer the top-level assets.roots property.

starter.description: Contains information about the Emulsify starter this project is based upon

repository.description: Git repository containing the starter this project is based upon

projectStructure.description: Compatibility configuration for Emulsify Core project structure. Prefer the top-level assets property for asset settings.

assetRoots.description: Compatibility alias for additional project-relative asset directories. Prefer assets.roots.

assets.description: Configures Emulsify Core asset discovery and output behavior.

roots.description: Additional project-relative directories containing static assets.

rebase.description: Whether Emulsify Core resolves asset aliases and repairs unresolved CSS asset URLs.

selfContainedOutput.description: Whether project assets remain under the build output so it can be deployed independently.

system.description: Contains information about the Emulsify system this project is utilizing

repository.description: Git repository containing the system this project is utilizing

checkout.description: Commit, branch, or tag of the system this project is utilizing

variant.description: Contains information about the Emulsify system this project is utilizing

repository.description: Git repository containing the system this project is utilizing

checkout.description: Commit, branch, or tag of the system this project is utilizing
